verdict.rationale: Slate's workspace-setup docs say it 'by default respects agent rules in the following order', which shows first-party support for project rule/instruction files the agent follows. The excerpt is truncated, so the actual file names, precedence order and format are not shown. Skills are separate, task-specific instruction packages and are not counted as a project instructions file. Missing for 10: the specific instruction file names and precedence order, an example of setting coding standards or conventions, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the agent follows them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows
